video_prompt: One continuous horizontal full-frame shot from the first frame to the last, filmed on a phone front camera on a tripod. The woman — a Latina woman about 29 years old with warm olive skin and dark-brown straight hair pulled back in a sleek high ponytail, thin gold chain necklace, wearing a white linen button-up shirt with an open collar — sits alone in a bright airy living room with a large window behind her covered by natural beige linen curtains glowing with soft daylight, a big monstera plant beside the window, a light wooden bench with a folded cream blanket, and stays exactly the same person the whole time: same face, same hair, same clothes, same position in the frame, same distance from the camera. The camera stays still and the room around her stays still and calm. She talks straight into the camera, sincere and a little worried, like confiding in a friend, with small natural head movements and small nods; her shoulders stay relaxed, her face stays centered in the frame, and between sentences her head settles back into the same upright, centered, front-facing resting pose she has in the first frame.
